items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: the third one got me into early Chopin. And believe me, I was so lucky that these people were there. Because if you can still play some of those Chopin etudes, you are a pretty good piano player.

ctx.x: Yes, of course I did. But you have to understand that the war was still on then and I was the same kind of kid as anybody, I didn’t really want to practice, even though I knew I had some talent even then. But luckily, my mother and father managed to send me to some different ladies, local ladies that, the first one taught me to read and play scales which I thank God for that she did that; the next one got me on to the Bach inventions; and the third one got me into early Chopin.
